detail: 'Current CTC' column mixes raw rupee salaries (e.g. 417964) with values already expressed in LPA (e.g. 4.2). 21 rows were already in LPA scale; all normalized to a single ctc_lpa (float) column.
Rows ['s1_23', 's1_29'] share email=rohit.verma13@mailtest.example.org phone=9000000294 but different name spellings ['R. Verma', 'Rohit Verma'] -> same person, kept first occurrence.

row s2_18: values shifted across columns (email_id='react, javascript, mysql' is not a valid email). Rotating fields recovers a record identical to an existing clean row (same worker) -> treated as corrupted duplicate and dropped.
'rate' column mixes hourly rates ('1415/hr') and monthly rates ('15k/month'). Normalized all to an estimated hourly INR rate (monthly / 176 working hours) into rate_hourly_inr.
'status' values appear as Active/active/ACTIVE/Inactive/paused - case-normalized to lowercase (active/inactive/paused).
9 email_id values are upper/mixed case - lowercased for matching.
Header row repeated at file line(s) [16] (looks like two exports concatenated) - removed extra header line(s) before parsing.
'Verified' column mixes Y/N/yes/No/Yes - normalized to boolean.

'Arjun Mehta' appears 2x with DIFFERENT phone numbers ['9000000131', '9000000272'] -> these are distinct people who happen to share a name. Kept as separate person records; NOT merged (would be a false-positive dedupe).
